job.title: Senior Associate Director - Rural Estate Management
job.description:
Senior Surveyor / Associate Director: Rural Consultancy & Estate Management
Location: Salisbury
Employment: Permanent | Full-Time
Sector: Rural Property | Estate Management | Rural Consultancy

The Opportunity
My client is a highly regarded national property consultancy with an established reputation across the rural and agricultural property market.

Due to continued growth, an opportunity has arisen for an experienced Rural Surveyor to join its Salisbury team at Senior Surveyor or Associate Director level.

The role will combine Estate Management with professional rural consultancy, advising a varied portfolio of landowners, estates and agricultural clients. The successful individual will take responsibility for key client relationships while working alongside specialists across a wider multidisciplinary property business.

This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious rural practitioner looking to develop their career, broaden their responsibilities and build a strong professional profile within the region.

The Role
Responsibilities will include:
  • Acting as lead agent for a portfolio of estate management clients.
  • Developing trusted relationships with landowners, estate owners and rural clients.
  • Providing strategic and day-to-day advice across rural property and landed estates.
  • Supporting senior colleagues on wider estate management and consultancy instructions.
  • Working collaboratively with specialists across other rural and property disciplines.
  • Undertaking secured lending and other professional valuations where appropriately qualified.
  • Preparing professional reports, recommendations and client correspondence.
  • Supporting and mentoring graduates and junior team members.
  • Identifying opportunities to develop existing client relationships and generate new instructions.
  • Building a strong professional network across Salisbury and the wider region.
  • Supporting business development, marketing initiatives and industry events.

About You
My client is seeking a commercially minded and personable rural property professional with strong technical capability and the ambition to continue progressing.

You are likely to demonstrate:
  • Experience within rural surveying, estate management or rural consultancy.
  • Experience advising rural estates, farms, landowners or agricultural clients.
  • The confidence to act as a key point of contact for clients.
  • Strong technical knowledge across a range of rural property matters.
  • The ability to provide practical and commercially considered advice.
  • Excellent communication and relationship management skills.
  • Strong organisation and attention to detail.
  • The ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively under pressure.
  • A collaborative approach and willingness to support colleagues.
  • An interest in business development and building a regional professional network.
  • Leadership potential and the ambition to progress professionally.
  • MRICS qualification would be highly desirable, although experienced rural practitioners working towards qualification may also be considered.

The Team
The Salisbury office provides a broad range of rural services including Estate Management, Consultancy, Valuation, Farming and Environmental advice.

The successful candidate will join an experienced multidisciplinary team advising a high-quality client base, including prominent landowners and rural estates across the region.

The breadth of expertise within the wider business also provides regular opportunities to work collaboratively on complex and varied instructions.

Career Development
This is a genuine progression opportunity for an ambitious rural professional. The successful individual will be encouraged to take increasing responsibility for client relationships, support junior colleagues, develop new business and establish themselves as a recognised adviser within the regional rural property market.

For candidates joining at Senior Surveyor level, there is clear scope to progress towards Associate Director and beyond.

Package & Benefits
My client offers a highly competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package, including:
  • Company car allowance.
  • Performance-related bonus.
  • Pension.
  • Up to 27 days' annual leave plus public holidays.
  • Option to purchase additional holiday.
  • Health Cash Plan and health screening.
  • Life assurance.
  • Group income protection.
  • Wellbeing support.
  • Gym, retail and travel discounts.
  • Cycle to Work scheme.
  • Interest-free season ticket loan.
  • Share incentive plan.
  • Financial and mortgage advice.
  • Professional development and career progression opportunities.
  • Company, sporting and charity events.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Rural Surveyor seeking greater responsibility, a strong client portfolio and long-term progression within a leading national rural property consultancy.

All applications and initial conversations will be treated in the strictest confidence.

job.title: Associate Director / Senior Associate Director – Estates & Farm Agency
job.description:
Associate Director / Senior Associate Director – Estates & Farm Agency

Up to £70,000 | £5,000 Car Allowance or Company Vehicle | Bonus

My client is a highly regarded national property consultancy with a longstanding reputation across the rural and agricultural property market.

An opportunity has arisen for an experienced rural property professional to join its Estates & Farm Agency team at Associate Director or Senior Associate Director level.

This is a senior, commercially focused role for an individual with strong rural property experience and, ideally, an established track record in the sale of farms, estates, land and other significant rural assets.

The successful individual will manage transactions from initial advice through to completion, while developing client relationships, generating new instructions and strengthening their profile within the rural property market.

The Role
Responsibilities will include:
  • Advising landowners and private clients on the sale of farms, estates, agricultural land and rural property.
  • Undertaking market appraisals and providing strategic pre-sale advice.
  • Winning new instructions through relationships, referrals, networking and proactive business development.
  • Preparing commercially focused recommendations and sale strategies.
  • Managing instructions from initial appointment through to completion.
  • Coordinating marketing collateral, property particulars, plans and photography.
  • Managing enquiries, purchaser relationships, viewings and negotiations.
  • Advising clients on offers, competitive bidding and transaction strategy.
  • Liaising with solicitors and professional advisers throughout the sale process.
  • Building relationships with farmers, landowners, investors, purchasers and rural professionals.
  • Monitoring market evidence and rural property activity.
  • Working collaboratively with colleagues across Rural, Valuation, Estate Management, Planning and wider property teams.
  • Representing the business at agricultural shows, industry events and professional functions.

Business Development
This is not purely an instruction-handling role. My client is particularly interested in individuals who can contribute commercially and develop their own market presence.
The successful candidate will be encouraged to:
  • Develop relationships with landowners, farmers, estate owners and professional advisers.
  • Identify forthcoming sales and off-market opportunities.
  • Generate repeat and referred business.
  • Build a recognised profile within the regional rural property market.
  • Attend relevant networking events and agricultural shows.
  • Cross-refer opportunities across the wider business.
  • Contribute to the growth and profitability of the Estates & Farm Agency division.

About You
The successful individual is likely to demonstrate:
  • Strong experience within the UK rural property sector.
  • Experience in farm agency, rural property transactions, valuation or a closely related discipline.
  • A proven ability to manage significant transactions and senior client relationships.
  • Strong knowledge of the agricultural and rural property market.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of fee generation.
  • The confidence to originate opportunities and win instructions.
  • Excellent negotiation, presentation and relationship-building skills.
  • The ability to operate autonomously at a senior level.
  • An established network within the rural or agricultural community would be advantageous.

A relevant degree is expected, with MRICS and/or FAAV/CAAV qualification highly desirable. Strong candidates with significant rural transactional experience may also be considered where their market experience compensates for a different qualification route.

Package & Benefits
The successful candidate will receive:
  • Basic salary up to £70,000, dependent on experience.
  • £5,000 car allowance or company vehicle.
  • Performance-related bonus.
  • Pension and comprehensive corporate benefits.
  • Excellent long-term progression opportunities.
  • Access to an established national rural property network.
  • Significant autonomy to develop client relationships and originate new instructions.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Rural Surveyor, Farm Agent, Associate Director or Senior Associate Director seeking a senior agency role with genuine scope to build their market profile and progress within a leading national property consultancy.

All applications and initial conversations will be treated in the strictest confidence.

job.title: Associate Director of Development Consultancy
job.description:
Associate Director / Senior Associate Director – Development

Central London | Full-time
Hybrid / Flexible Working

My client, a highly regarded national property consultancy backed by a major international real estate group, is looking to appoint an experienced development professional to its established London team.

This is a senior, client-facing role combining development expertise, client leadership and business development. The successful individual will help grow the London Development business, leading key relationships, generating new instructions and providing strategic advice across development opportunities.

There is flexibility around seniority, with candidates considered at Associate Director, Senior Associate Director and potentially Director level depending on experience, market profile and work-winning capability.

The Role
Responsibilities will include:
  • Leading relationships with developers, landowners, investors, housebuilders and other key clients.
  • Identifying, originating and converting new business opportunities.
  • Leading pitches, proposals and client presentations.
  • Providing strategic and commercially focused development advice.
  • Advising on development potential, feasibility, viability and market considerations.
  • Supporting clients with land acquisition, disposal and development strategy.
  • Managing instructions from initial opportunity and fee proposal through to delivery.
  • Working closely with colleagues across Planning, Agency, Valuation, Research and other specialist teams.
  • Identifying cross-selling opportunities across the wider property business.
  • Developing repeat business and expanding the team's client base.
  • Representing the business at client meetings and industry events.
  • Supporting junior colleagues and contributing to the continued growth of the London Development team.

About You
My client is interested in established property professionals who combine strong development knowledge with commercial awareness and the ability to develop and win client relationships.

You are likely to have experience within development consultancy, development advisory, development surveying or a closely related property discipline.

Ideally, you will demonstrate:
  • Strong experience within the development property market.
  • A good understanding of the development lifecycle and land.
  • Experience advising on residential and/or mixed-use development.
  • Knowledge of development viability, feasibility and appraisal principles.
  • Strong knowledge of the London and/or South East market.
  • A track record of developing client relationships and generating new instructions.
  • Experience pitching for and winning work.
  • Strong commercial judgement and an entrepreneurial approach.
  • Confidence advising senior clients.
  • Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
  • The ability to work collaboratively across multiple property disciplines.
  • MRICS or another relevant professional qualification would be advantageous, although market experience, relationships and a proven track record are equally important.

Seniority
At Associate Director level, this could suit an established project and client lead who is increasingly developing their own network and generating opportunities.

At Senior Associate Director level, candidates are likely to have a strong record of winning work, managing key relationships and contributing to revenue growth.

Exceptional Director-level candidates with an established market profile and strong client network will also be considered.

Ultimately, capability, commerciality and fit are more important than job title.

Why Join?
This is an opportunity to join an established property consultancy with a strong UK platform and the backing of a major international real estate group.

The role offers considerable scope to build your own client relationships, originate work and develop your market profile while drawing on expertise across Development, Planning, Residential, Agency, Valuation and Research.

For an ambitious development professional, this represents an opportunity to take a prominent role within the London team and contribute directly to its next stage of growth.

Package & Benefits
A competitive salary and overall package will be offered depending on experience and seniority, alongside benefits including:
  • Company car allowance
  • Discretionary bonus
  • Hybrid/flexible working
  • 27 days' annual leave plus public holidays
  • Private medical cover
  • Pension and life assurance
  • Group income protection
  • Health and wellbeing support
  • Private GP services
  • Cycle to Work scheme
  • Discounted gym membership
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Season ticket loans
  • Share incentive plan
  • Retail and lifestyle discounts
  • Professional learning and career development

Benefits are subject to eligibility and applicable scheme rules.

For a confidential conversation about the opportunity, please apply or get in touch directly.

job.title: Regional Manager – Wealth Management - Durban (South Africa)
job.description:
Regional Manager: Wealth Management
Location: Durban, South Africa
Sector: Wealth Management / Financial Services
Reports to: Managing Director
Package: Competitive monthly salary, regional performance override and personal production commission structure

About the opportunity
Our client is an established international wealth management business with a strong presence across South Africa. The business provides holistic financial planning, investment, offshore wealth, fiduciary and client advisory solutions to individuals, families and business owners.

The company is now looking to appoint a Regional Manager for its Durban office. This is a senior leadership appointment and represents an opportunity to take responsibility for an established regional team while helping build the next phase of growth in KwaZulu-Natal.

This is not a purely administrative or corporate management role. The business is looking for a senior financial services professional who remains an advisor at heart. The successful person will lead the Durban region, manage and develop the existing team, support advisors in unlocking new client opportunities, and continue to advise clients and build their own book.

The Durban office is already established, with an experienced advisor base. The opportunity is therefore not to rebuild from scratch, but to take a strong existing platform and help it perform at a higher level.

The role will suit someone who enjoys leading people, working with clients, driving commercial performance and building a regional presence. The successful person will be expected to combine strategic leadership with hands-on advisory credibility.

Key responsibilities
  • Regional leadership
  • Lead and manage the Durban region, ensuring strong commercial, operational and cultural performance.
  • Work closely with the Managing Director and wider leadership team to implement regional growth plans.
  • Take ownership of regional performance, team productivity, client service standards and operational effectiveness.
  • Represent the business professionally in the Durban market and wider KwaZulu-Natal region.
  • Support the continued development of the company’s regional presence and market share.
  • Advisor coaching and team development
  • Lead, coach and mentor the regional advisor team.
  • Support advisors in improving performance, identifying opportunities and developing stronger client relationships.
  • Work with established advisors to unlock additional production and improve commercial outcomes.
  • Attend client meetings with advisors where appropriate to support more complex or higher value opportunities.
  • Help create a positive, accountable and high-performance team culture.
  • Support the recruitment, onboarding and development of future advisors as the region grows.
  • Personal advisory and business development
  • Continue to advise clients personally and build a book within the business.
  • Develop new client relationships through referrals, networking, professional partnerships and market engagement.
  • Identify opportunities across wealth planning, investment management, offshore solutions, retirement planning, risk, protection and fiduciary needs.
  • Maintain personal production and contribute directly to regional revenue growth.
  • Operate as both a leader and a commercial producer.
  • Client relationship management
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, introducers, stakeholders and strategic partners.
  • Ensure high standards of client service across the Durban region.
  • Support the resolution of escalated client matters where required.
  • Identify opportunities for client retention, deeper advice, cross-selling and broader use of the company’s services.
  • Promote the full client proposition across local and offshore wealth management.
  • Operational management
  • Oversee the day-to-day running of the Durban region.
  • Ensure operational consistency, service quality and adherence to company processes.
  • Work with central support teams across operations, compliance, finance, HR and marketing.
  • Manage regional reporting, performance information and operational requirements.
  • Support process improvement and ensure the region operates efficiently.
  • Oversee relevant local administrative and support functions within the Durban office.
  • Compliance and risk
  • Promote a strong culture of compliance, professionalism and ethical advice.
  • Ensure adherence to relevant regulatory requirements, including FAIS, FICA, AML, POPIA and internal governance standards.
  • Support compliance reporting, audit processes and risk management requirements.
  • Ensure advisors maintain appropriate professional standards and fit-and-proper requirements.

Candidate profile
The successful candidate is likely to be an experienced wealth management, financial planning or financial services leader who has remained close to clients and commercial production.

The business is looking for someone who can lead an established team, but who still understands what it takes to originate business, advise clients and build a book.

The ideal candidate will have:
  • Strong experience in wealth management, financial planning, private wealth, financial advisory, banking, insurance, investment services, or a related financial services environment.
  • A proven record of client relationship management and business development.
  • Experience leading, coaching or managing financial advisors or sales professionals.
  • The ability to improve advisor performance and create a stronger sales and client service culture.
  • A strong understanding of local and offshore wealth management solutions.
  • Commercial confidence and the ability to work to regional and personal revenue targets.
  • The credibility to sit with high value clients and senior advisors.
  • The ability to manage both the commercial and operational requirements of a regional office.
  • A professional, client-centric and performance-focused approach.
  • The willingness to remain actively involved in advising clients.
  • Qualifications and experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, commerce, economics, accounting, law or a related discipline preferred.
  • Relevant financial planning, wealth management or investment qualifications advantageous.
  • CFP accreditation or progression towards CFP would be highly regarded.
  • RE5 qualification advantageous.
  • Postgraduate qualification advantageous.
  • Minimum 5 to 10 years’ experience in financial services, wealth management, financial planning, banking, insurance or investment services.
  • Minimum 3 to 5 years’ experience in a leadership, management, regional or senior advisory role.
  • Experience in a wealth management or financial advisory environment strongly preferred.

Remuneration structure
  • The role offers a competitive monthly salary, dependent on experience, qualifications and commercial fit.
  • In addition, the successful candidate will participate in:
  • A regional override structure linked to team production.
  • Commission on personally generated business.
  • A structured advisor commission model for local and offshore business.
  • The structure is designed for someone who wants to lead a region while still benefiting from personal client production and regional growth.

What kind of person will succeed?
This role will suit someone who:
  • Is an advisor at heart.
  • Enjoys building client relationships.
  • Can lead experienced advisors without needing to micromanage them.
  • Has the confidence to coach, challenge and support strong performers.
  • Wants to grow a regional business.
  • Is commercially driven and comfortable with targets.
  • Can combine leadership with personal production.
  • Understands the importance of compliance and professional standards.
  • Is comfortable being visible in the office, with clients and in the market.
  • Wants to be part of a growing wealth management business with strong local and offshore capability.

Why this opportunity?
  • This is an opportunity to take on a senior regional leadership role within an established wealth management business, leading an experienced Durban team and helping build the next phase of growth in the region.
  • The role offers the right person a blend of leadership, client advisory work, regional business building, commercial reward and long-term growth potential.

Application process
  • Suitable candidates will initially have a confidential discussion with James & Partners Talent.
  • Shortlisted individuals will then be introduced to the client for a structured interview process.
  • The process is expected to include initial meetings with senior leadership, followed by a more detailed discussion around role fit, commercial structure and regional opportunity.

job.title: Chartered Historic Building Surveyor
job.description:
Chartered Historic Building Surveyor 

Taunton

Salary: Up to £50,000 

 

The Opportunity

My client, a highly prestigious and globally recognised property consultancy, is seeking a Chartered Historic Building Surveyor to join their established Architecture & Building Surveying team in Exeter or Taunton offices. Renowned for delivering exceptional work across heritage, rural estates, and high-value property portfolios, this organisation offers a unique platform to work on some of the UK’s most historically significant and architecturally important assets.

This is an excellent opportunity for a surveyor with a genuine interest in historic buildings and conservation to develop their career within a collaborative and forward-thinking environment.

 

The Role

Working within a multidisciplinary team of surveyors, architects and rural specialists, you will deliver a broad range of professional and project-based building surveying services, with a particular focus on heritage assets.

Responsibilities will include advising on the preservation and conservation of historic buildings, undertaking detailed building surveys and preparing reports, and managing contract administration across a range of projects. You will also be responsible for preparing specifications, schedules of work and tender documentation, as well as delivering planned maintenance programmes and schedules of condition.

The role involves regular client interaction, including advising on procurement routes, contractor appointments and statutory compliance, while building and maintaining strong client relationships and acting as a key point of contact.

 

About My Client

My client is widely regarded as one of the most prestigious and respected property consultancies in the UK and internationally. With a long-established reputation for excellence across rural, residential and commercial sectors, they are known for delivering high-quality advice on complex and often high-profile projects.

Their multidisciplinary approach and extensive national presence enable them to provide a truly comprehensive service. The business places strong emphasis on collaboration, professional development and long-term client relationships, offering an environment where individuals can thrive and build a meaningful career.

 

Requirements

  • MRICS qualified (or equivalent professional accreditation)
  • Minimum of 2 years’ post-qualification experience
  • Experience within building surveying, ideally with exposure to historic or listed buildings
  • Strong understanding of CDM regulations, building regulations and health and safety
  • Ability to manage client relationships and deliver work to a high professional standard
  • Commercial awareness and project delivery experience
  • Full UK driving licence

 

Perks and Benefits

  • Salary up to £50,000
  • Car allowance
  • Discretionary bonus scheme and competitive overall package
  • Generous annual leave, including additional loyalty and charity leave
  • Private medical scheme, virtual GP access and employee assistance programme
  • Life assurance and group income protection
  • Pension scheme and share incentive opportunities
  • Interest-free travel loans and support with rental deposits
  • Enhanced maternity, paternity and family support benefits
  • Access to a wide range of retail discounts and lifestyle perks
  • Cycle to Work scheme and wellbeing initiatives
  • Ongoing training, mentoring and structured career development pathways
  • Opportunity to participate in social, sporting and charitable activities

Senior Ecologist
job.description:
Senior Ecologist / Principal Ecologist / Ecologist

Norwich | East Anglia | Hybrid Working

An established and highly regarded multi-disciplinary environmental and rural consultancy is looking to appoint an Ecologist, Senior Ecologist or Principal Ecologist to join its growing in-house Ecology & Environmental team in East Anglia.

 

This is an excellent opportunity to join a forward-thinking consultancy delivering a broad portfolio of ecology, biodiversity and land recovery projects across the region. The team is continuing to expand in response to growing demand around Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG), habitat banking, landscape recovery and environmental planning.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to work across a diverse range of projects including Preliminary Ecological Appraisals (PEAs), protected species surveys, Ecological Clerk of Works (ECoW), habitat management planning, BNG assessments and wider ecological consultancy services.

 

The business is flexible on level and welcomes applications from experienced Ecologists through to Senior and Principal level candidates.

 

Key Responsibilities

• Undertaking Preliminary Ecological Appraisals (PEAs), UKHab surveys and protected species surveys

• Delivering Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG) assessments and supporting habitat banking and landscape recovery projects

• Producing high-quality technical reports and ecological documentation

• Managing projects and coordinating survey programmes

• Liaising with clients, landowners, planners, contractors and multidisciplinary teams

• Supporting ecological mitigation, habitat enhancement and restoration initiatives

• Undertaking Ecological Clerk of Works (ECoW) duties where required

• Supporting and mentoring junior team members (Senior/Principal level)

• Using GIS/QGIS to support habitat mapping and ecological assessments

• Ensuring projects are delivered in line with current wildlife legislation, planning policy and best practice guidance

 

Candidate Requirements

• Degree (or higher) in Ecology, Environmental Science or a related discipline

• Experience within ecological consultancy

• Strong report writing and communication skills

• Experience with PEAs, habitat surveys and protected species work

• Knowledge of UK wildlife legislation and planning policy

• Membership of CIEEM or eligibility to apply

• Full UK driving licence

Desirable Experience

• Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG) assessments

• UKHab surveys and habitat condition assessments

• GIS/QGIS experience

• Protected species licences

• FISC accreditation

• Ecological Clerk of Works (ECoW) experience

• River restoration, freshwater ecology or habitat banking experience

 

Why Apply?

• Excellent opportunity to join a growing ecology function with genuine progression opportunities

• Diverse project portfolio across ecology, biodiversity and natural capital

• Flexible level of appointment depending on experience

• Supportive and collaborative working environment

• Hybrid working model

• Flexible basic salary available for the right candidate

 

For a confidential discussion regarding this opportunity, please get in touch directly.

job.title: Associate Director of Planning
job.description:
Associate Director of Planning

Associate Director, Planning (Multiple Locations)

Locations: Key locations including Guildford, Lewes, Cirencester and Salisbury

Contract: Permanent, Full-Time

Salary: Competitive + excellent benefits

About the Opportunity

We are working with an established national UK property consultancy with a historic reputation for combining deep local market expertise with strategic, commercially-driven planning and land advisory services. The business operates through a network of 50+ offices across England and Scotland, providing specialist support in residential, commercial, rural and strategic land sectors, and forms part of a wider global real estate group with international reach and resources.

This is a key senior planning appointment, with hiring focused in key locations including Guildford, Lewes, Cirencester and Salisbury, offering the opportunity to lead challenging and varied planning projects, shape planning strategy, and contribute to the growth of a respected national planning team.

The Role

As an Associate Director, Planning, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading a range of planning applications, appeals and Local Plan matters.
  • Advising landowners, developers and land promoters on planning strategy and delivery.
  • Leading your own projects from inception to successful completion.
  • Supporting senior colleagues with complex cases and contributing to practice development initiatives.
  • Building long-term client relationships and, over time, developing your own client base.

You will operate within a supportive, collaborative multidisciplinary environment with access to expertise in development management, estate management, strategic land and wider commercial property teams.

What We’re Looking For

Essential Requirements

  • MRTPI qualified (Chartered Town Planner) with demonstrable career progression and planning delivery experience.
  • Strong client-facing skills with the ability to manage stakeholders at all levels.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and reporting skills.
  • The ability to work well within a team while managing competing priorities and deadlines.
  • A proactive, commercially astute individual with a flexible, solution-orientated approach.

Competencies

  • Agility in managing multiple tasks and shifting priorities.
  • Initiative and self-motivation with minimal supervision.
  • Commercial awareness with a focus on delivering high standards of client service.
  • Strong organisational skills, including time and budget management.
  • A commitment to continuous professional improvement and quality delivery.

Person Specification

  • A natural team player with the aspiration to build a strong professional reputation and local profile.
  • The ability to form and maintain effective relationships with clients, colleagues, advisors and external partners.
  • Strong project management skills with a track record of delivering successful planning outcomes in a timely manner.

Professional Skills & Qualifications

  • Chartered membership of the RTPI.
  • Excellent research and analytical capabilities.
  • High proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and internet research.

Benefits Package

Our client offers an award-winning benefits programme designed to support and reward employees, including:

Health & Leisure

  • Private medical insurance
  • 27 days annual leave + public holidays (option to purchase up to 5 additional days)
  • Health screening and wellbeing support
  • Gym and leisure discounts
  • Cycle-to-work scheme
  • Eye care vouchers
  • Travel and retail discounts
  • Volunteering opportunities
  • Social events, sports teams and charity involvement

Financial & Professional

  • Workplace pension
  • Company car allowance
  • Life assurance at 8× basic salary
  • Group income protection (long-term disability)
  • Interest-free season ticket loan
  • Bonus scheme eligibility
  • Share incentive plan
  • Financial planning and mortgage advice support

Why This Role Matters

This is a rare opportunity to join a truly national planning team that combines deep local insight with strategic land advisory capability, trusted by private estates, developers and institutional clients alike. The successful candidate will enjoy a high level of autonomy, the chance to work on diverse schemes across residential, mixed-use and strategic land portfolios, and the platform to accelerate their professional profile.
